android.desc:
Mark Auto Screenshot deleter is a smart screenshot manager and screenshot cleaner designed to help you manage screenshots the moment you take them.

If you often capture temporary screenshots for receipts, chat messages, order confirmations, addresses, notes, reference images, or reminders, Mark helps you stay in control without letting them pile up in your gallery. Instead of manually cleaning screenshots later, you can decide right away what should happen to each one. Mark helps keep your gallery clean, reduce clutter, and free storage by removing screenshots you no longer need.

Whenever you take a screenshot, Mark instantly shows a quick popup dialog with a preview and simple actions. You can choose from 3 timer options to auto-delete the screenshot after your selected time, and you can fully customize these timer values in the app to match your own habits. If the screenshot is important, you can keep it permanently. You can also preview it before deciding, so managing screenshots feels fast, clear, and effortless.

Mark is built for temporary screenshots that only matter for a short time. Many screenshots are useful only for a few minutes or hours, but they stay in your phone much longer and slowly clutter your gallery. Mark solves that by helping you automatically delete temporary screenshots before they become a mess. This makes it easier to keep your screenshots organized, clean gallery clutter, and save storage space over time.

The app also includes powerful sharing options directly from the popup dialog. You can choose Share & Keep if you want to send the screenshot and save it, or Share & Delete After X Time if you only need to share it temporarily. This makes Mark especially useful for people who frequently share screenshots but do not want those images left behind in the gallery afterward.

For even faster cleanup, Mark includes Silent Auto Delete mode. In this mode, the popup dialog does not appear, saving time and effort. Instead, every new screenshot is automatically scheduled for deletion using a predefined timer set by you in the app. This is perfect for users who take lots of temporary screenshots and want a fully automatic screenshot cleaner without extra taps.
